* Unlike most trinkets, Ioun Stones have an actual visual effect on your character - a soft glow matching its color will slowly rotate around you.
* Can be found in several locations:
** Random loot and end reward at loot level ~5 at a very low drop rate
** [[The Dreaming Dark (quest)|The Dreaming Dark]]'s end reward has a high chance of offering random Ioun Stones every completion.
** Completing the [[The Dreaming Dark (quest)|The Dreaming Dark]] three times (and every third time thereafter) will guarantee players a single random Ioun Stone, crafting items, and random loot from its end reward list.
* '''NOTE:''' When this item runs out of charges, it will be ''destroyed'' unless it had been upgraded first.
